title: Builder BLD-303: Theme lens

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-303.

detail: B3 Lenses, pass BLD-303 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-303). Theme lens. Scope: components/builder/theme. Build: Hover a theme: swap the static theme stylesheet and data-theme on the canvas; prefetch on hover. Unpinned sections show the theme's default variant; commit is one undo step. Done when: Switching makes no document request once cached; Pinned variants never change on switch. Gates: check:theme-conformance, audit:themes render matrix, check:build-budget and check:shell-weight, Pass probes, check:contrast, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-108. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-303.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
